files.rationale: Took PR B's restructured component (new FullScreenPortal props, useShallow, separate fullScreenPlayerRef, its own fullscreen time-sync effect, seekTime, lyrics/status features) because it already does what PR A was for: the fullscreen ReactPlayer plays whenever isPlaying is true (its playing={isPlaying && isFullScreen} only renders inside the isFullScreen portal), so A's playing={isPlaying} change and A's playerRef-based seek effect are covered by B's dedicated sync logic and would be redundant against B's split refs.
